content: Hyperbeam feature docs describe kiosk mode specifically as hiding Chromium navigation UI, and its Chromium session API exposes a start URL and configurable timeout settings; their roles guide describes control, clipboard, upload, and other permissions separately. For a shared window that must include browser chrome, do not enable kiosk/hide-navigation mode; defer clipboard, uploads, profile persistence, and other high-risk capabilities. This is a narrow product-feature comparison, not a security guarantee.
